comparator.name: Communicatie- en Informatiewetenschappen
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official curriculum totals 180 ECTS: 60 ECTS of common communication and academic-skills courses in year 1; 30 ECTS of philosophy, programming and research methods plus 24 ECTS in one theme and a 6-ECTS elective in year 2; and a 30-ECTS minor or exchange window, 18 ECTS of structured choice and a 12-ECTS bachelor thesis in year 3. The generic registry target does not name one of the six themes, so the first-listed theme, Bedrijfscommunicatie, is instantiated by neutral official-order tie-break. Open minor and compulsory-choice space remains open rather than being populated with assumed courses.

components.note: Structured choice among a second theme, an internship plus theme courses, or courses from other themes.

notes.text: Tilburg requires sustained communication research, a 24-ECTS thematic sequence, academic-language work and a 12-ECTS bachelor thesis. UCR can combine rhetoric, media, organisational study, social issues and digital methods in several coherent ways, but these schedules do not reproduce that full specialist sequence.
